title: Phototransistor optocoupler (GaAs infrared LED + NPN phototransistor)

functions.text: Current through the LED (pins 1 to 2) turns the phototransistor on: collector current is at least 20% of the LED current (CTR min 20% at IF 10 mA, VCE 10 V). LED forward voltage 1.25 V typ, 1.50 V max at 20 mA. VCE(sat) 0.4 V max at IC 2 mA, IF 16 mA. No LED current: collector dark current 50 nA max at VCE 10 V.

electrical.notes: Limits, not recommended conditions: LED IF 100 mA max, VR 3 V; collector current 50 mA max; VCEO 30 V; BVCBO 70 V min; BVECO 7 V min. outputMaxVoltageV = VCEO.
